items.title: What Does Freeport McMoRan (FCX) Gain From Its British Columbia Copper Push?
items.summary: Freeport-McMoRan (NYSE:FCX) agreed to acquire a 51% interest in the Aurora West copper gold project in British Columbia from TDG Gold. The agreement grants Freeport-McMoRan an option to further increase its stake in Aurora West through additional exploration expenditures. Freeport-McMoRan is funding further work at the JOY Copper Gold District with Amarc Resources to increase its joint venture interest.
